title: Model 2 C3 recovery comparison
summary: On 70 admitted pairs in a disclosed second look, mean IoU was 0.58914 for C3, 0.58316 for C, and 0.46878 for P. C3 minus C was +0.005985 with a 14-day interval of [-0.005435, 0.015853], a NO_PASS result. C3 minus P was +0.12036 with an interval of [0.10256, 0.14324].
scope: Aggregate Model 2 recovery comparison of C3, C, and P on the previously exposed June-September 2026 cohort.
